task: Add a WCAG 2.4.1 skip-to-main-content link as the first focusable element in App.tsx and an id="main-content" anchor on PageLayout.tsx's <main> element.

key_reasoning.reason: Two components touched (App.tsx, PageLayout.tsx). Baseline S (self-contained, same UI layer, no coordination complexity) bumped to M because PageLayout.tsx is a shared layout component consumed by ~40 pages directly plus 23 more via Layout.tsx — a core shared utility.

The project's accessibility-patterns.md guide documents the exact markup and target id convention, and the App.tsx-first-child-ordering nuance (ahead of Banner) is already resolved in technical-analysis.md. Baseline S bumped to M because there is a genuine open scope question — whether StandaloneLayout.tsx (sign-in/sign-up/login-success/error pages, no <main> landmark, not wrapped by App.tsx) is in scope — left explicitly unresolved and could double the file-change surface if included.

sr-only is an established 14+-file convention; only focus:not-sr-only is net-new but is a stock Tailwind utility requiring no config change, and rollback is trivial (revert two small edits). Baseline S bumped to M because this is a WCAG 2.4.1 accessibility-compliance requirement (Security/Compliance red flag).
